headline: U.S. Strikes Iranian Air Defenses; Russia Launches Massive Kyiv Attack
subheadline: CENTCOM disables blockade-runner M/V Huda in Gulf of Oman as IRGC claims two tankers struck mines near Hormuz Strait today
lede: President Trump confirmed U.S. forces conducted limited strikes on Iranian air defenses today, while Iranian media reported casualties at Jask port and Tehran threatened retaliation against U.S. interests. Simultaneously, U.S. CENTCOM disabled the St. Kitts-flagged M/V Huda for breaching the naval blockade, and the IRGC claimed two tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz. In Ukraine, Russia unleashed a massive overnight missile and drone barrage on Kyiv, damaging the Northern Bridge, residential buildings, and energy infrastructure, causing casualties and widespread power outages. Ukrainian forces responded by striking the Saratov Oil Refinery and destroying two Iskander launchers and a Pantsir-S1 system in Bryansk.

sections.title: Russia's Massive Kyiv Barrage; Ukraine Strikes Back
sections.body: Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv overnight, damaging the Northern Bridge, residential buildings, and energy infrastructure, causing casualties and power outages across Zhytomyr and Chernihiv regions. Ukrainian intelligence identified Colonel Fedir Zubakov and four Su-34 aircraft as responsible for the Komishuvakha gymnasium strike that killed 55 people. Ukrainian forces struck the Saratov Oil Refinery, with a capacity of 7 million tons annually, and hit two Iskander launchers and a Pantsir-S1 system in Bryansk. Meanwhile, Ukrainian and Russian delegations prepare for peace talks in Abu Dhabi as NATO Secretary General Rutte warned that compromises will be necessary and Ukraine is unlikely to recover all its territory.

sections.title: U.S. Strikes Iran; Blockade Expands, Tankers Hit
sections.body: President Trump confirmed U.S. forces conducted limited strikes against Iranian air defenses today, with Iranian media reporting casualties at Jask port and a senior official threatening revenge against U.S. interests in the region. U.S. CENTCOM disabled the St. Kitts-flagged M/V Huda with precision munitions in the Gulf of Oman for repeatedly attempting to breach the naval blockade, while the IRGC Navy claimed two oil tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. military established the 'Iron Gate' task force to expand the blockade to Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea. Multiple explosions were reported in Qeshm and Jask, UAVs were spotted near Marivan, and anti-aircraft fire erupted in Sanandaj, as Israeli artillery shelling continued along the Lebanese border and former IDF Chief Gadi Eisenkot was tasked with forming a new Israeli government.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous U.S. strikes on Iranian air defenses and the expansion of the naval blockade via the 'Iron Gate' task force signal a coordinated pressure campaign extending beyond maritime domains. Russia's sustained multi-domain offensive against Kyiv, employing hypersonic Tsirkon and Iskander-M missiles alongside Shahed drones, demonstrates an intent to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses and degrade critical infrastructure ahead of Abu Dhabi talks. The appointment of Stephen Miller, a vocal critic of Ukrainian aid, as White House Chief of Staff introduces a significant political variable into the peace negotiation calculus.
